envelope.reason: the sign has to spell the CLI form the spec names and the gate blocks a bare spelling

payload.title: implementer role sign spells its CLI read inside a residue reference span
payload.body: The residue gate admits only σ* anchors in a dimension value, so --plan and <unit> cannot appear bare; the implementer sign spells cratylus plan show <unit> --plan <plan> inside an escaped reference span, which the gate treats as opaque code and which projects as a literal dollar-brace span. Also the handoff autonomy value was dropped from the implementer because it shapes a report and the role returns a name. Haiku cold reads said the name returns to the assayer; the text never names the recipient.
